The existing `CONFIG.bounds.tempC` (70–100 C) already governs shot entry and latest-shot validity, but `grindGuidance` previously accepted a restored all-five-green shot with invalid recorded temperature as proven same-coffee grind and as Slow Feed paired evidence. This can misleadingly transfer corrupted archival measurements into a new next-shot estimate. No real-member incident or cup-quality improvement claimed.

- Preserve every raw shot, five ratings, notes, private History, independent styles, existing temperature rules and optional `null` temperature.
- Narrowly filter measured-grind evidence within `grindGuidance` only; do not rewrite stored shot records or alter broad recommendation/temperature policy.
- Add six synthetic real-module positive/negative regressions (high/low invalid, valid, unrecorded, mixed, Slow Feed), including immutability.
- SAME-COMMIT receipt in `docs/workstreams/issue-455.md`, parent development `55a0c4d80d934f12b91550a848c87c3b06dd4a61`.

**Verification:** PR-head exact-source Node22 + lint, applicable browser/mobile/offline, SQL/security/governance if risk router requires. Frozen603 not an inherited PASS. Do not merge on failures; no deploy, provider writes or product-policy changes. Follow with a separate documentation/queue reconciliation PR after verified merge.

Closes no issue. Research evidence ledger and #455 remain open.
